title: Necromancer Kael Armor Quests

page_purpose_classification.rationale: Seven-piece Velious armor exchange walkthrough, not just a title/index.

source_branch_audit.note: All current effective Lua handlers read in full; canonical maintained copies verified byte-identical. Recursive findProposals snapshot had no pre-existing source/quest-row overlap. Full cached NPC pages read as identity/location context, not quest-reward numeric authority.

reviewed_facets.dialogue_and_reachability: The page leaves intro and detailed dialogue unwritten; retained ProjectEQ-derived hail → necromancer → tasks progression is coherent. Corrected gloves text from one crushed topaz to three, established by checklist and existing hand-in. Malformed wiki gloves prose does not override the explicit 3x checklist.
reviewed_facets.item_counts_and_rewards: All seven checklist triples were independently parsed, resolved against exported items, and matched to complete hand-in branches. Exactly one armor item plus three named gems gives one named reward. The existing component audit was corroborated, not treated as behavioral proof.
reviewed_facets.cash_xp_faction: Page documents experience without a numeric amount. Page mentions faction without naming quest-faction recipients or magnitudes; retain current same-family values, not certified by this page. NPC-page faction amounts describe kills, not armor turn-ins, and are not substituted. No cash reward is documented or granted.
reviewed_facets.gates: Quest-only faction restrictions are deliberately bypassed. Existing no-class/no-level predicate remains; no item quantities or item equip masks are loosened.
reviewed_facets.refund_and_repeat: Every branch falls through to shared return_items; no partial acceptance, one winning elseif per offer, no script state, repeated complete offers reward again. Tests cover incomplete/foreign/empty offers, successful coin retention and repeat behavior at isolated-mock level.
reviewed_facets.acquisition_and_dependencies: Item identities and NPC IDs/static placements cross-checked against the exported tables with proposal overlays. Component source zones are described in the page; live acquisition and selection filters are not established by static candidates.

adaptations: Friendly quest-faction access is intentional; actual faction deltas and combat/merchant rules remain unchanged.
No added class/level gate; no changed requirements, rewards, XP, faction values, repeat or return behavior.
unresolved: Exact numeric XP/faction magnitudes are not established by the cached quest pages.
All four-slot offers require simultaneous armor plus three gems in this script; no persisted multiquest credit is implemented or claimed tested.
Ordinary item acquisition, loot probabilities, NPC availability after content filtering, real transaction settlement/rollback, persistence, and rendered dialogue/UI remain unverified.
Cached class pages list minimum levels 45/50, but cached Velious Class Armor explicitly says there is no level requirement. Preserve no level gate.
Intended class and reward equip mask do not alone establish a hard turn-in class predicate; existing generated no-class-gate behavior is preserved, not promoted into a generic class bypass policy.

The source is generated. The authoritative armor generator/dialogue inputs are absent from this export and must be synchronized in the game repository before regeneration; this proposal changes only maintained Lua and its matching quest row.
Retained Kael quest-faction set differs from original ProjectEQ variants: no Coldain loss is reintroduced; only Paladin Kael explicitly lists all four retained directions in this assigned set.
